result.finding: The project is a multi-module application combining two types: (1) a Web Application with server-side rendering (Thymeleaf MVC) and REST endpoints in the 'web' module, and (2) a Background Worker / Message Consumer service in the 'worker' module that processes image thumbnails via RabbitMQ.
evidence: Spring Boot web/REST annotations found (analyze.sh output)
web/src/main/java/.../controller/HomeController.java: Spring MVC controller with Thymeleaf templates (upload.html, list.html, view.html)
web/src/main/java/.../controller/S3Controller.java: REST-style endpoints for S3 file operations
worker/src/main/java/.../WorkerApplication.java: Spring Boot application with AMQP listener (no web server)
worker/src/main/java/.../service/AbstractFileProcessingService.java: RabbitMQ message consumer for image processing
values: Web module: Web Application (Spring MVC + Thymeleaf server-side rendering) with REST endpoints
Worker module: Background Service / Message Consumer (Spring AMQP RabbitMQ listener)
Overall pattern: Web App + Background Worker architecture
